rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically scrolling through a phone or webpage.

example.english: I scroll on my phone while travelling to pass the time.
example.traditional: 我搭車嗰陣會碌一碌手機，打發吓時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 ce1 go2 zan6 wui5 luk1 jat1 luk1 sau2 gei1 daa2 faat3 haa5 si4 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for the quick-skim slice of the sense, when someone briefly looks through text rather than moving through it line by line.

example.english: I scroll through the news headlines before eating to see if anything important happened.
example.traditional: 食飯前我掃一掃新聞標題，睇吓有咩大事。
example.jyutping: sik6 faan6 cin4 ngo5 sou3 jat1 sou3 san1 man4 biu1 tai4 tai2 haa5 jau5 me1 daai6 si6

rows.note: Use this for a rolled manuscript or other written scroll, rather than digital scrolling.

example.english: The museum houses a precious scroll.
example.traditional: 博物館入面收藏住一卷珍貴嘅卷軸。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 sau1 cong4 zyu6 jat1 gyun2 zan1 gwai3 ge3 gyun2 zuk6
